scripts.build: node scripts/check-release.mjs && python3 scripts/prepare-v2-assets.py && vinext build
scripts.export:preview: PC2_BUILD_MODE=preview npm run build && PC2_BUILD_MODE=preview python3 scripts/package-static.py
scripts.export:production: node scripts/check-release.mjs --production && PC2_BUILD_MODE=production npm run build && PC2_BUILD_MODE=production python3 scripts/package-static.py
scripts.export:pages: npm run build && python3 scripts/package-static.py && python3 scripts/prepare-pages.py
scripts.check:v3: node scripts/check-film-timing.mjs && node scripts/check-v3-states.mjs && python3 scripts/check-v3-export.py && tsc --noEmit
